test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three Statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All watches are cameras.

No camera is a pen.

Some watches are balls.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some balls are cameras.

II. No ball is a pen.

III. No pen is a watch.

options.text: Both conclusions I and III follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
Given Statements:

All watches are cameras.

No camera is a pen.

Some watches are balls.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d5e0dd039e18da64a666f61a389cbff4520e3eaf3fe7abad8a83c7630ce7f33.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some balls are cameras. - True (It is given that some watches are balls and all watches are cameras, so, the balls which is watches is also cameras).

II. No ball is a pen - False (There is Not any definite relation is given between ball and pen, so it can be possible only).

III. No pen is a watch - **True** (It is given that all watches are cameras and no camera is pen, so, watches are also not pen).

So, Both conclusions I and III follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
